metadata.description: Curated collection of Claude Code plugins for software development — code review, architecture analysis, implementation workflows, and dev tooling.

plugins.name: auto-memory
plugins.description: Session observability and memory/knowledge maintenance — a statusline (tokens, cost, context %, rate limits), per-session token logging, and a manual /mdv-wrap-session skill that routes what is worth keeping into rules or memories and refreshes knowledge files in the live session.

plugins.name: code-review
plugins.description: Code review and debugging toolkit — 3-pass reviews of files and of GitLab MRs or GitHub PRs, MR comment resolution, root-cause debugging, optimization analysis, and refactoring cleanup.

plugins.name: architecture
plugins.description: Architecture and codebase analysis — tech stack detection, convention extraction, backend/frontend pattern analysis, and two-phase project mapping into an Obsidian vault (what a system can do, then how its critical paths actually work).

plugins.name: implementation
plugins.description: End-to-end implementation workflow — requirements clarification, spec writing, task planning, and implementation, closed by a review gate.

plugins.name: database
plugins.description: Database schema, query, and migration reviewer — checks performance, security, and correctness of SQL and ORM usage.

plugins.name: dev-workflow
plugins.description: Developer workflow tools — git branching and worktrees, commit preparation, time and cost estimation, integration proposals, an English-language policy for repositories, and HTML-to-PDF rendering.

plugins.name: frontend-design
plugins.description: UI and UX work end to end — design an interface from an existing codebase, optimize an existing one via competing proposals, or build distinctive components that avoid generic AI aesthetics.

plugins.name: security
plugins.description: Language- and stack-agnostic security audit. Detects the application class, gates focus areas to that class, runs scanners in parallel, and produces a prioritized markdown report plus a machine-readable findings.json.
